aawc_migration_county_building_rating_average = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = aawc_migration_county_building_rating_sum
			has_variable = aawc_migration_county_rated_holding_count
			var:aawc_migration_county_rated_holding_count > 0
		}
		value = var:aawc_migration_county_building_rating_sum
		divide = { value = var:aawc_migration_county_rated_holding_count }
	}
	round = yes
}
